summary: Phase 0 RidePact full end-to-end test. Backend: 22/22 pytest cases pass across health, auth (register/verify/login/me/forgot/reset), admin role gating, public reference lists, and PATCH /users/me. Mobile: 7/7 UI flows pass — Welcome, Signup→Verify (dev code shown on screen)→Home, tab bar (Home/Find/Chat/Profile + raised '+' create), Profile shows email+reliability+Logout, and Sign-In with seeded jdoe@university.edu lands on Home. Backend health, domain rejection (400), duplicate (409), weak password (400), unverified login (403), admin health/stats (200 with counts), all confirmed. No deprecated Expo packages (expo-av / expo-barcode-scanner / expo-background-fetch) detected.

minor.issue: Response envelope shape {"data":[...]} exposes Mongo _id and __v on university documents. Consider stripping _id/__v from public list endpoints.

issues: React Native web console warning: '"shadow*" style props are deprecated. Use "boxShadow".' Emitted from components using shadowColor/shadowOpacity/shadowRadius/shadowOffset in inline styles (TabBar.jsx L41-47, profile.jsx L59). Migrate to `boxShadow` or platform-guarded style for RN >= 0.76 web.

react_native_issues.issue: Deprecated shadow* style props on web (RN warning). Reference: /app/frontend/components/TabBar.jsx:41-47 and /app/frontend/app/(tabs)/profile.jsx:59

action_items: Consider omitting Mongo `_id` and `__v` from public list endpoints (/api/universities, /airports, /destinations, /calendar); expose `id` instead for consistency.
Replace RN inline shadow* style props with `boxShadow` (or Platform.OS split) to silence the deprecation warning surfaced on web preview — see TabBar.jsx and profile.jsx.
critical_code_review_comments: authController.register accepts empty `username`/`name` strings silently; consider a minimum-length guard so users don't land on Profile with 'Student' fallback.
universities/airports/destinations list responses leak internal Mongo fields (_id, __v). Should be shaped consistently with `toPublic`-style serialization.
seed_data_creation: Test registers a fresh unique @university.edu user per run (email prefix qa_<random>) and exercises password reset on it. No teardown implemented — accepted for Phase 0 dev DB; users remain in the collection.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend proxied via FastAPI :8001 → Node :8500 is stable. Use EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL + `/api`. Register requires a UNIQUE @university.edu email each run (unique index). DEV_MODE=true so register response includes devVerificationCode and forgot-password returns devResetToken. Seeded users: admin@ridepact.com/Admin@12345 (admin) and jdoe@university.edu/Passw0rd! (verified student). Mobile Verify screen renders the 6-digit dev code on-screen (matches 6-digit regex in body text). Create tab is a Phase 2 placeholder — not a bug.
rca_of_issue: N/A — no failing feature. Only minor: (1) list endpoints leak Mongo _id/__v (serialization polish), (2) RN web deprecation warning about shadow* props. Neither blocks Phase 0.
